Name: Pregnancy Odds
Author: Camileer
Description:
[size=4][b]Overview:
[/b][/size]
Introduces pregnancy odds to the vanilla "Should we have a baby"-Event for Player x NPC and Player x Player pregnancies.
Works in Multiplayer.
Adoptions remain untouched by this.

NOT COMPATIBLE WITH SURPRISE PREGNANCY. I’ll work on a config option for it to achieve a similar effect.

Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12869]Planned Parenthood[/url].
Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20743]Pregnancy Choice[/url].
If any of the mods mentioned above are installed, the question won't be configurable, if you enter/choose something in the config regarding the question, nothing will be affected. The pregnancy odds will still work though.

Via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ you can configure 
[list]
[*]the odds for pregnancies
[*]if pregnancies for Player X Player should be odds-based (if you disable this, the game will use the unmodified vanilla code, pregnancies guaranteed)
[*]if pregnancies for Player X NPC should be odds-based (if you disable this, the game will use the unmodified vanilla code, pregnancies guaranteed)
[*]choose alternative questions for "Should we have a baby" or enter a custom one
[/list]

The bed and crib textures are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34389]Cute Cribs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34250]Cute Beds[/url], I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37076]Bed Textures Combo Pack [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29698]Additional Vanilla Child Beds[/url].

[b][size=4]Recommended Mods:
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6578]Pregnancy and Birth Events[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10494]Todders Like Parents[/url] or ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]
[/list]
I’ve also added an experimental beta version of “PregnancyOddsExpanded” > feedback welcome but expect bugs.


Source Code at: [url=https://github.com/camiska/PregnancyOdds]https://github.com/camiska/PregnancyOdds[/url]﻿feel free to fork, or open up PRs or propose changes
